name: MinCIT
body: HSTS, a permanent https redirect, Secure cookies, and FAQ-style content. But the home page sends its visits to two GA4 properties, so two dashboards count the same people and can tell different stories.
lesson: Make one GA4 property the source of truth, and document why any second exists.
summary: www.mincit.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 13 pass. Fix first: analytics may count some visits twice.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 18 pages send to more than one GA4 property.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: 18 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /servicio-ciudadano, /servicio-ciudadano/tramites-y-servicios, /servicio-ciudadano/canales-de-atencion, /ministerio/contratacion and 14 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 19 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /inicio, /servicio-ciudadano, /servicio-ciudadano/tramites-y-servicios, /servicio-ciudadano/canales-de-atencion and 15 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: 13 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /servicio-ciudadano (91), /servicio-ciudadano/tramites-y-servicios (113), /servicio-ciudadano/canales-de-atencion (74), /ministerio/contratacion (67) and 9 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: 5 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 41 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
